name: What is the difference between a kitchen remodel and a kitchen renovation?
description: A remodel updates aesthetics, while a renovation involves more extensive changes, including layout and system reconfigurations.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a kitchen remodel and a kitchen renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: While often used interchangeably, a kitchen remodel typically refers to updating the aesthetics, such as new cabinets, countertops, or paint, without changing the layout. A kitchen renovation, on the other hand, usually involves more extensive changes, including altering the layout, moving walls, or reconfiguring plumbing and electrical systems, resulting in a more significant transformation of the space.
acceptedAnswer.description: A remodel updates aesthetics, while a renovation involves more extensive changes, including layout and system reconfigurations.
